description: This file defines the InstallerController class in the OrangeHRM system, extending the AbstractInstallerVueController. It is responsible for handling pre-rendering logic related to the installation process, notably setting the current component and updating the state container with the installation screen.

classes.name: InstallerController
classes.description: Handles installation process pre-rendering logic within the installer module, extending the abstract installer Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the install process screen component and updates the state container to reflect the current installation screen.
